verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes an official OpenAPI 3.0.3 "Data Access API" for reading errors, projects, and organization data, with documented Authentication, Pagination, Rate Limiting, and Versioning pages. A community user also scripted a dump of exceptions through the API, which suggests list/query and event retrieval work. The evidence does not show updating issues (status or assignment changes) via the API, and it does not describe token scoping, only that an Authentication page and manual API tokens exist. Missing for 10: documented issue-update endpoints, explicit raw-event fetch endpoints, scoped/permissioned tokens, independent hands-on corroboration of the current API.
